INFORMED CONSENT FOR THE HOUSEHOLD-LISTING

(to be read at each household)

Hello, my name is __________________________ and I am from the Population Council Consulting, an NGO based in New Delhi. We are implementing the study on behalf of the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)

Population Council Consulting is conducting a study in selected districts of Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan to understand the feasibility of collecting data on safety as perceived by people in the study district. The study is being conducted in 1 district each of Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh including in your district . In each of the selected districts we will systematically interview about ~2500 persons aged 18 or above from both rural and urban areas, and your village/ward/block is one of them.

For the study, first we need to list all the persons aged 18 years or above and collect information about their access to mobile phone as part of the study will be done using mobile phone. For this, I would like to ask you some questions about your household and some of your household members to determine if anyone could be included in this research study. This usually takes a few minutes to complete; no money or gifts will be provided. Whatever information you provide will be kept private. Participation in this survey is voluntary and you can choose not to answer any question or all questions. However, we hope that you will participate in this survey since your participation is important to us. If people in your household are selected to be part of the next phase of the research study, we may come back and ask you or a family member to volunteer to participate in the study.
